newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Zagrebacka Banka H1 pre-tax HRK 108 mln.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Zagrebacka Banka H1 pre-tax HRK 108 mln.

text.p: Croatia's leading commercial bank Zagrebacka Banka d.d. posted a 108 million kuna first half pre-tax profit, compared to a loss of 50.6 million kuna in the same period of 1995, according to preliminary figures.
Advance January-June profit tax payments totalled 14.0 million kuna, the Zagreb Stock Exchange reported on Tuesday. But no bank officials were immediately available for comment.
The bank had made a 124.3 million kuna net profit in 1995.
Zagrebacka reported a 35.9 percent rise in operating income to 613.0 million kuna between January and June thanks to more than doubled net interest income, compared to a year ago.
Interest income, totalling 367.3 million kuna for the first six months, accounted for just under 60 percent of all its earnings and the rest were various services.

The bank said it increased the volume of business by granting more loans to companies and citizens on the back of higher deposits and some foreign borrowing, while boosting its liquidity reserves at the same time.
First half operating costs rose 5.1 percent to 327.1 from 310.7 million kuna as it enforced cost cutting measures.
Because of a strong rise in deposits since the end of last year, the bank's total assets rose 8.8 percent to 17.6 billion kuna. They stood at 14.0 billion on June 30, 1995.
In June, Zagrebacka launched a private placement for 10 percent of its stock abroad. The issue was priced at 468 kuna per share, raising 71.4 million kuna for the bank.
Its global depositary receipts (GDRs), issued at 10 to each share, were subsequently listed in London on Seaq International. They have recently traded at around $15 each.
Due to steady investor interest, particularly among foreign institutional buyers, the price of Zagrebacka's ordinary shares has climbed to 730 kuna on the Zagreb Stock Exchange.
It peaked at 760 kuna in July. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
